_comment: Curated 'official' MCP servers fronted by the shared active APIM (service: infra/modules/apimcore.bicep; MCP children: infra/modules/mcpgateway.bicep), gated on an APIM subscription key. ACTIVATED: this catalog registers the Foundry toolbox 'ai4ia-toolbox' and enableOfficialMcp/enableFoundryToolbox are true in main.parameters.json. A `foundryToolbox: true` entry omits upstreamUrl; main.bicep computes it from the deployed primary project endpoint (<projectEndpoint>/toolboxes/<name>/mcp), so this catalog is portable across subscriptions/tenants/environments. To register an EXTERNAL MCP server instead, add an entry with an explicit https upstreamUrl and upstreamAuthMode, e.g. { "name": "ms-learn", "displayName": "Microsoft Learn", "description": "Official Microsoft Learn MCP server", "upstreamUrl": "https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp", "upstreamAuthMode": "none" }.

servers.name: ai4ia-toolbox
servers.description: AI4IA shared Foundry toolbox: grounding, code execution, tool search. Fronted through the official-MCP APIM.
